ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows the annual precipitation distribution along the 35° latitude line of a certain continent. Location C is located on the inland side, and the annual precipitation is obviously relatively low, at about a relatively low level; from C toward the direction close to the west coast of the continent, the precipitation increases obviously. Then reason: The moist air flow near the 35° latitude line mainly enters from the ocean side on the west coast. The windward side of the mountains on the west coast has more precipitation, while C is located on the inland side behind the mountains. Blocked by the mountains, water vapor is difficult to reach, so precipitation is low. From the rule that windward slopes are rainy and leeward slopes are less rainy, it can be known that C is located on the leeward slope.

raw_record.question_text: According to <image1>, one reason for the low annual precipitation at location C is that it is located in what topographic position?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中丙位于靠近大陆西岸的内陆一侧，年降水量低，旁边向大陆西岸方向降水明显升高。再结合题干给出的35°纬线位置，判断湿润气流主要从西岸海洋一侧进入，西岸山地迎风侧降水多，而丙在山地后方降水少。由迎风坡多雨、背风坡少雨的规律，回答丙处位于背风坡。

method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是某大陆沿35°纬线的年降水量分布示意图，纵轴为年降水量，横轴从大陆西岸到大陆东岸。丙处所在的降水段明显偏低，大约处在400毫米左右；它附近有降水量较高的地段，表现出水汽在地形抬升一侧降水较多、越过山地后另一侧降水减少的空间差异。再推理：题目问“丙处年降水量少的一个原因是它位于什么地形位置”，在地形位置表述中，能解释山地阻挡水汽后少雨的是“背风坡”。因此丙处少雨的原因之一是位于背风坡。
